commands: kubectl get namespace quant-staging 2>&1 || kubectl create namespace quant-staging 2>&1
kubectl -n quant-staging get deployment quant-quantmail 2>&1 || kubectl -n quant-staging create deployment quant-quantmail --image=$IMAGE --port=3010 2>&1
kubectl -n quant-staging set image deployment/quant-quantmail quant-quantmail=$IMAGE 2>&1
